stem:
Chipo and Farai are in partnership as transport operators in Mutare, sharing profits and losses in the ratio 3 : 2. Their partnership agreement provides for:

- interest on fixed capitals at 6% per annum;
- interest on drawings at 10% per annum;
- a salary for Farai of US\$8,400 per annum;
- interest at 7.5% per annum on any loan made by a partner.

The following information is available for the year ended 31 December 2025:

|  | Chipo US\$ | Farai US\$ |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Capital account (fixed) | 46,000 | 35,000 |
| Current account at 1 January 2025 | 2,150 Cr | 1,240 Dr |
| Drawings | 12,800 | 27,600 |
| Date of drawings | 1 April 2025 | 1 July 2025 |

On 1 January 2025 Farai lent the partnership US\$14,000. The draft net profit for the year was US\$46,830. No interest on the loan has been paid or recorded; it is to be credited to Farai's current account.

parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: Calculate the corrected net profit for the year.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Calculate the residual profit to be shared in the profit-sharing ratio.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: Prepare the appropriation account for the year ended 31 December 2025.

points.description: Net profit 45,780 and interest on drawings added (960, 1,380)
Interest on capital (2,760, 2,100) and Farai's salary 8,400 deducted

stem:
Bulawayo Bowling Club is a non-trading concern. Its assets and liabilities at 1 January 2025 were:

|  | US\$ |
| --- | ---: |
| Clubhouse equipment (net book value) | 14,600 |
| Bar inventory | 1,830 |
| Subscriptions in arrears | 435 |
| Bank | 3,065 |
| Subscriptions in advance | 270 |
| Bar payables | 1,145 |
| Rates owing | 380 |

A summary of its receipts and payments account for the year ended 31 December 2025 showed:

|  | US\$ |
| --- | ---: |
| Subscriptions received | 12,960 |
| Bar sales | 21,470 |
| Competition fees received | 1,860 |
| Paid to bar suppliers | 14,370 |
| Barman's wages | 3,120 |
| Greenkeeper's wages | 9,600 |
| Rates | 2,450 |
| Repairs to greens | 1,725 |
| New equipment | 2,350 |

At 31 December 2025: subscriptions in arrears were US\$515 and in advance US\$345; bar inventory was US\$2,015; bar payables were US\$1,290; rates owing were US\$395. Equipment is depreciated at 10% per annum on the net book value at 1 January plus additions during the year.

parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: Calculate the accumulated fund at 1 January 2025.
parts.explanation: Assets 19,930 − liabilities 1,795 = 18,135. Subscriptions in advance are a liability; treating them as an asset gives 18,675.
parts.workedSolution: 1. Assets 19,930 − liabilities 1,795 = 18,135. Subscriptions in advance are a liability; treating them as an asset gives 18,675.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Prepare the subscriptions account for the year ended 31 December 2025.

points.description: Opening arrears 435 debit and opening advance 270 credit

Closing balances c/d (advance 345 debit, arrears 515 credit) and b/d
